title: Input Types
description: Use input types for mutation arguments.

data.text: Input types group related arguments together. They are especially useful for mutations that accept complex data.
Use `[InputType]` on a class to make it an input type. Public properties become input fields.

data.title: Input Type
data.content: Group book creation fields into an input type.

data.text: Input types can reference other input types, letting you build complex nested structures.

data.title: Nested Input
data.content: Nest address inside a create author input.

data.title: Validation
data.text: Use data annotations like [Required] and [StringLength] on input types. Hot Chocolate automatically validates them before resolvers run.
Use `List<T>` for array inputs and nullable types (`int?`) for optional fields.

data.title: Lists and Optionals
